Offline PROJ 9.6 runtime and database from OSGeo4W, installed with QGIS 3.40.7. QGIS application code is not included. Catalog includes authority definitions, including geographic, vertical, compound and deprecated entries; only current projected metre systems are offered as working CRSs. Network is explicitly disabled. Only a subset of datum grids is bundled. Additional licensed grids can be provided in proj-data beside SkyLab-Rust.exe. Missing best transformations fail, without approximate datum shifts.
Dependencies: PROJ (MIT); libcurl (curl license); OpenSSL (Apache 2.0); SQLite (public domain); libtiff (libtiff license); libjpeg-turbo (IJG/BSD/zlib); libwebp/libsharpyuv (BSD with patent grant); Lerc (Apache 2.0); zstd (BSD option); zlib (zlib); liblzma (0BSD/public domain; see COPYING). Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime is a system prerequisite and is not redistributed here. See LICENSE-* and copyright_and_licenses.csv.
